faq_heading: 2 bedroom condos in South Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: What is the price of a 2 bedroom condo in South Surrey right now?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom condos in South Surrey, 192 sold over the past year at a median of $555,000, with the middle half between $510,000 and $616,000.

faq.q: Are 2 bedroom condos in South Surrey selling quickly?
faq.a: The median was 29 days, and homes sold for 97.0% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which parts of South Surrey sell the most 2 bedroom condos?
faq.a: King George Corridor, with 107 of the 192 sales at a median of $560,000.

faq.q: Which buildings in South Surrey have 2 bedroom condos for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Madison (10 sales, median $647,000); King + Crescent (9 sales, median $595,000); Edgewater (8 sales, median $696,250); Southwynd (8 sales, median $545,000).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom condo in South Surrey?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom condos that sold in South Surrey was $500 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom condos in South Surrey compare
A 2 bedroom condo in South Surrey sold for $70,000 more at the median than a 1 bedroom one ($555,000 against $485,000, 43 sales). The strata fee was $500 a month against $354.
A 2 bedroom condo in South Surrey sold for $262,500 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($555,000 against $817,500, 14 sales). The strata fee was $500 a month against $631.
Of the 9 cities with 2 bedroom condo pages, South Surrey has the 4th highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $383,000 and Tsawwassen highest at $614,000.
